consumer: The frontend paperdoll renderer, asking 'what does the GUI display in the wielded slot and each worn body-part slot?'
scope: The avatar's displayed equipment view: the wielded item plus worn items mapped to their body-part coverage slots, not the whole carried inventory.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items, which flattens wielded_items() + worn + full inv_const_slice() into one carried_items[] array tagged only by a coarse 'wielded'|'worn'|'inventory' string with no slot/body-part mapping.
divergence: An avatar wearing a hat, a coat covering torso+arms, and gloves while carrying loose items in a backpack: the flat array intermixes inventory items with worn items and gives no body-part slot per worn piece, so the paperdoll cannot place the coat across torso/arms or separate equipment from carried clutter.
